title: Architecture
text: The application separates a Spring Boot API, a React client, and infrastructure adapters. Controllers coordinate use cases while services own business rules.

title: Async jobs
text: Resume analysis and document vectorization run through Redis Streams. Producers persist a pending task and consumers acknowledge it after a successful update.

title: Hybrid retrieval
text: The retrieval pipeline combines BM25 lexical scores with pgvector cosine similarity and an optional reranker. Query length controls the candidate top K.

title: Provider registry
text: A provider registry stores OpenAI-compatible base URLs, chat models, embedding models, and encrypted API keys. One provider can be marked as the default.

title: Structured output
text: StructuredOutputInvoker validates JSON against a schema and retries with a repair prompt when the model returns malformed data.

title: File deduplication
text: Uploaded files are hashed with SHA-256 before storage. A repeated hash reuses the existing object and avoids duplicate vectorization work.

title: Voice interview
text: The voice workflow uses WebSocket messages for session state, realtime ASR subtitles, and streamed TTS audio. A silence debounce prevents premature commits.

title: Evaluation
text: Interview answers are evaluated in batches and persisted as a report with category scores, evidence, and a final recommendation.

title: Object storage
text: The storage adapter uses the AWS S3 SDK so RustFS, MinIO, and other S3-compatible endpoints can share the same application contract.

title: Database schema
text: Flyway owns the relational schema and creates the vector extension and HNSW index. Hibernate runs in validate mode in production.

title: Security controls
text: Provider credentials are encrypted at rest, benchmark endpoints require a local token, and uploaded files are checked against allowed media types and size limits.

title: Observability
text: Actuator health checks and Micrometer Prometheus metrics expose task latency, provider calls, and failure counters for operational dashboards.
